economy.zh:
过去24小时，全球市场经历了剧烈波动。美股在创纪录高位后遭遇周五抛售潮，标普500指数单日跌幅逾2%，半导体板块领跌，VIX恐慌指数飙升。与此同时，欧洲央行释放强烈鹰派信号，市场押注年内两次加息以应对逼近3%的通胀，令欧元区经济滞胀担忧加剧。中国经济数据方面，5月外汇储备环比增加317亿美元至3.44万亿美元，但一个深层矛盾浮出水面：海外投资者通过互联互通机制无法买入内地最热门的AI股票，监管层正着手修补这一漏洞。同花顺社区动态显示，周期品涨价（锡价半年涨40%）与新股密集发行成为散户焦点，一家深圳公司股价暴跌后报警引发热议。

- **[Wall Street's 'fear gauge' punches back as the 'crash up' in chip stocks finally reverses](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/06/wall-streets-fear-gauge-punches-back-as-the-crash-up-in-chip-stocks-finally-reverses.html)**：半导体板块此前的“暴涨式上冲”在周五彻底逆转，英伟达等龙头单日跌幅超5%，VIX终于追上其他波动指标，市场情绪从亢奋急转至恐惧。
- **[Abel goes his own way with new Berkshire investments, including billions for AI](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/06/abel-goes-his-own-way-with-new-berkshire-investments-including-billions-for-ai.html)**：巴菲特接班人Greg Abel完成首笔重大交易，大手笔押注人工智能，证明伯克希尔资本配置正从传统价值转向科技未来。
- **[ECB Steps Up as G7’s Lead Hawk With Interest-Rate Hike Primed](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQOHQ2cTBlTHBFMnNTVGtKYnJzN01LTDRXSzlOd2NVWVNRd1ZHQnlEcllwMGNZbXNDNVl5ZGk3c0hfRnltbXFFRThFZjczT0NxM3Q0ZVlrVlpvZlJKR3hQN3BSR0pXbjFDV0hPNEloVmlpVzd3VnVEUkU3dXV3NmtGX2QwSHZfYzVUbVlrLS0yX2NaZTFQbkRVVHYwNmtoZThKUnk2LVhTLWgzOVk1OVlrY0pB)**：欧洲央行成为G7中最鹰派的央行，市场已完全定价年内两次加息，但欧元区经济增速放缓使这一路径充满争议。
- **[The Stock Connect problem: why can’t investors buy the mainland’s top AI stocks?](https://news.google.)**：港股通机制的设计缺陷导致国际投资者无法分享中国AI板块的IPO盛宴，证监会主席已表态将加强程序化交易监管，暗示可能改革。
- **[锡价半年飙涨40％下的资源暗战，锡业股份1.77亿元押注“北方锡都”胜算几何？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5ZeXFBb082X0xzTGM5SW92V2lQY1RPZVFBQzdGSnZIb2JWaklZNlZPdUNiWHc1Q0lOTHNaY2N5QWh5STdmWUxVU2FGX2lfSUhwR1VkV0lLRklLTmpQRUE)**：锡期货价格半年暴涨40%，锡业股份斥资1.77亿元布局内蒙古资源，反映稀缺小金属在AI和新能源需求下的战略价值。

**后续观察**：下周焦点是欧洲央行6月会议是否释放明确加息信号，以及美股回调是否引发更大规模去杠杆。中国程序化交易新规细节值得关注，香港奢侈品零售数据将是验证“财富中心”成色的关键指标。
economy.en:
Markets ended a turbulent week with a sharp selloff as the VIX finally caught up with semiconductor stock reversals, while global central banks signaled further tightening. The ECB is primed to hike rates twice amid a stagflation dilemma, and China's forex reserves rose modestly as its regulators moved to curb program trading. Hong Kong's luxury mall sector booms on wealth hub status, yet mainland investors remain locked out of top AI stocks via Stock Connect. Meanwhile, Berkshire's new CEO Greg Abel made his first major AI investment, and a new crypto craze in HYPE ETFs emerged as bitcoin cratered.

- **Wall Street's 'fear gauge' spikes** as the monster rally in chip stocks reverses, ending a week that saw record highs erased. The VIX finally caught up with other volatility metrics [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/06/wall-streets-fear-gauge-punches-back-as-the-crash-up-in-chip-stocks-finally-reverses.html).
- **Abel goes his own way** at Berkshire Hathaway, committing billions to AI in his first major deal since succeeding Warren Buffett [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/06/abel-goes-his-own-way-with-new-berkshire-investments-including-billions-for-ai.html).
- **Bitcoin plunges to 2024 lows** while a new Wall Street hype pivots to HYPE ETFs linked to hyperliquid platforms [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/06/bitcoin-price-crash-crypto-hype-hyperliquid-etfs.html).
- **ECB hikes loom** as inflation climbs toward 3% and growth stagnates, pushing the central bank to act as the G7's lead hawk [Bloomberg via Google News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQOHQ2cTBlTHBFMnNTVGtKYnJzN01LTDRXSzlOd2NVWVNRd1ZHQnlEcllwMGNZbXNDNVl5ZGk3c0hfRnltbXFFRThFZjczT0NxM3Q0ZVlrVlpvZlJKR3hQN3BSR0pXbjFDV0hPNEloVmlpVzd3VnVEUkU3dXV3NmtGX2QwSHZfYzVUbVlrLS0yX2NaZTFQbkRVVHYwNmtoZThKUnk2LVhTLWgzOVk1OVlrY0pB).
- **China's forex reserves** rose to $3,442.238 billion in May, up $31.691 billion month-on-month, signaling resilience despite capital outflow pressures [第一财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE12WFlKRm5ucDd0U3U3cUhDUzhBbkZ0OERBb0ctY2QyS0xLT0lyc1dadGttanZzUDBDbjN0b2VSM1VPMl9Edjh3VVllRFNsMFNjSENn).
- **Stock Connect fails investors** seeking mainland's top AI stocks, as recent blockbuster AI IPOs remain out of reach for cross-border traders – a structural bottleneck [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3356193/why-cant-investors-buy-mainlands-hottest-ai-stocks-stock-connect).
- **Hong Kong luxury malls thrive** on the city's new status as the world's top cross-border wealth hub, with hard luxury and jewellery posting consecutive months of robust growth [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3355967/its-wealth-effect-hong-kong-luxury-malls-thrive-amid-ipo-gains-housing-recovery).

**Watch next:** Focus on how the ECB's actual rate decision (expected in July) will impact European risk assets and the dollar-euro dynamic, and whether the US stock selloff deepens into the new week as chip earnings season approaches. The opening of Stock Connect to AI stocks could be a major catalyst for Chinese tech valuations if regulators address the bottleneck.

society.zh: 今日社会新闻板块呈现三大主线：中东冲突持续升级，美伊互袭、以色列击杀黎巴嫩将军，同时美国防长在诺曼底演讲将移民比作“入侵”引发争议；东亚方面，韩国选举混乱引发大规模抗议，日本皇室与AI话题并行，中国高考日全国护航，同时AI对就业与收入的影响讨论升温；知乎社区动态显示平台面临营收下滑，AI商业化成为焦点，同时娱乐八卦与垃圾信息混杂。以下为各子专栏详情。
society.en:
The past 24 hours have been marked by a sharp escalation in the Middle East, with direct US-Iran strikes in the Gulf and an Israeli attack killing a Lebanese general, while the Ukraine war reached a new psychological threshold as drones targeted St. Petersburg for the first time. Geopolitical tensions extended to the Indo-Pacific as the Aukus debate reignited in Australia and Chinese President Xi Jinping made a rare visit to Pyongyang. Meanwhile, domestic politics in South Korea were rocked by election protests, and China entered its annual Gaokao exam cycle amid broader debates on AI's impact on wages.

- **US and Iran exchanged strikes in the Gulf** on June 6, testing the fragile ceasefire. The US struck Iranian drones and radar sites, while Tehran claimed attacks on US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain. This marks the most direct US-Iran military engagement in months, raising the risk of a broader conflict ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/7/how-many-times-were-the-us-and-iran-on-the-verge-of-a-deal?traffic_source=rss)).
- **Israel killed a Lebanese general and two other soldiers** in a strike on their vehicle in south Lebanon. The incident threatens to open a second front against Hezbollah as the IDF investigates ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cj0g8jymg92o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)).
- **Ukrainian drones struck St. Petersburg** in what Russia called an 'unprecedented' attack, prompting the first stay-at-home order for the city's residents since the war began. The strike demonstrates Ukraine's growing long-range capability ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cg7498kz808o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)).
- **US Defense Secretary Hegseth used a D-Day anniversary speech** to attack European migration policies, calling it a 'beach invasion.' The rhetoric signals a deepening transatlantic rift ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c802e7jk458o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)).
- **Australia's Aukus nuclear submarine deal came under fire** as Greens warned it risks war with China. PM Albanese insisted the program is 'full-steam ahead,' but the political debate reopens ahead of a possible election ([The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/jun/07/greens-warn-nuclear-submarines-deal-risks-war-with-china-as-albanese-says-aukus-full-steam-ahead)).
- **Xi Jinping visited North Korea** for the first time in seven years, amid significant military developments and growing US-Israel-Iran tensions. The visit signals Beijing's determination to stabilize its northeastern flank ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/7/why-is-chinese-president-xi-jinping-visiting-north-korea-now?traffic_source=rss)).
- **Pope Francis began a seven-day tour of Spain**, praising the country's opposition to war and support for migrants, a subtle counterpoint to Hegseth's criticism ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c8d2pgjy4qgo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)).
- **The Pentagon reportedly raised the threat level on Israeli espionage to 'critical'** amid US-Israel war with Iran and ceasefire talks, highlighting growing mistrust between the allies ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/6/pentagon-said-to-raise-threat-level-on-israel-spying-to-critical?traffic_source=rss)).

**Watch next:** The US-Iran ceasefire hangs by a thread as both sides trade strikes; any further escalation could draw in Gulf states and disrupt global oil markets. South Korea's election rerun demands and Armenia's parliamentary vote will shape domestic stability. The wave of AI-related stories from China and Japan suggests a policy pivot that could reshape labor markets.

tech.zh:
今日科技新闻呈现三条清晰主线：特朗普政府以‘股权换主导权’深度介入AI生态，同时将最先进AI系统交予军方；中国AI人才争夺战持续升级，腾讯挖角OpenAI核心研究员；汽车产业在军事电动化、充电基础设施痛点与中美政策博弈中快速分化。此外，游戏行业进入夏季展示周，社交应用正从大平台向兴趣社区迁移。以下是关键动态：
- **[Trump's latest memo puts 'most advanced AI in the world' into the military's hands](https://www.engadget.com/2188929/trump-latest-memo-puts-most-advanced-ai-in-the-world-into-military-hands/)**：特朗普签署备忘录，将‘世界最先进AI’移交军方，并要求企业未经批准不得修改军用模型，标志美国AI治理从商业主导转向国家安全优先。
- **[The Trump administration might take an equity stake in OpenAI](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/06/the-trump-administration-might-take-an-equity-stake-in-openai/)**：同日传出特朗普政府正谈判入股OpenAI，旨在‘让美国人民从AI成功中获益’，若落地将打破私营企业与政府资本的传统边界。
- **[Tencent Hires Former OpenAI Researcher Yao Shunyu As Chief AI Scientist In AGI Push](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQcS14QVR5UWxhZi1lZmc2a0ZnV1NNOTNjQXN5U2tqdWNYcjFpSzBLbTZuNHJEQTBsZk5aZ0JWMG1hNjYyWWJsRG5pRzE4Vkppa1lIN21qMmVaWm1TQVZmRTV3SVlIeG9oX1QzMWFranNpTTVPWG5TV2NrSzhibkVJdDVmbnpvUTJXNVp3)**：腾讯聘请前OpenAI研究员姚顺宇担任首席AI科学家，直接对标AGI，反映出中国科技巨头在全球人才招募上的激进策略。
- **[All the new EVs you can buy with 0% financing in June 2026](https://electrek.co/2026/06/06/all-the-new-evs-you-can-buy-with-0-financing-in-june-2026/)**：包括特斯拉Model Y在内的多款电动车提供0%融资，显示厂商在需求放缓下正通过金融工具刺激销量。
- **[Summer Game Fest 2026: All the news from gaming’s busiest week](https://www.theverge.com/games/939206/summer-game-fest-playstation-xbox-gaming-events-2026)**：PlayStation、Xbox等平台开启夏季游戏展示周，聚焦《战神：劳菲》等第一方大作，为行业注入叙事驱动内容新预期。

**后续观察**：特朗普政府对AI的‘国家化’操作可能重塑全球AI产业竞争格局——若OpenAI被纳入政府利益结构，其商业中立的伦理承诺将面临考验。与此同时，腾讯对AGI人才的押注与Meta用AI生成点击诱饵新闻（[Meta made its own AI-generated clickbait news feed](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/944235/meta-app-ai-clickbait-articles)）形成反差，提示AI落地方向正分裂为‘基础设施级’与‘流量工具级’。汽车行业的充电基础设施矛盾（[When public charging stations aren’t so public](https://electrek.co/2026/06/06/when-public-charging-stations-arent-so-public-and-why-it-matters/)）仍是EV普及的最大绊脚石，而特朗普对华EV工厂的开放态度（[Trump open to Chinese EV plants in U.S. despite warnings](https://news.google.)**）则为中美贸易博弈增加了新变量。
tech.en:
Today's tech landscape is dominated by a major U.S. policy pivot on AI, a wave of gaming announcements, and evolving dynamics in electric vehicles. The Trump administration is moving to embed cutting-edge AI into military operations and is reportedly considering taking an equity stake in OpenAI, signaling a new era of public-private entanglement. Meanwhile, China continues its aggressive talent poaching, with Tencent hiring a former OpenAI researcher to lead AGI efforts. The summer gaming season kicked off with major showcases from PlayStation, Xbox, and indie events, while the automotive sector saw a military-grade autonomous truck program launch and a growing controversy over access to public EV chargers. The Hacker News community highlighted a long-standing Valve networking bug and the aesthetic rise of liminalism.

- **AI Meets the Military:** Trump's latest memo puts 'most advanced AI in the world' into military hands, preventing companies from altering AI models used by the Pentagon without prior approval ([Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2188929/trump-latest-memo-puts-most-advanced-ai-in-the-world-into-military-hands/)).
- **Washington Eyes OpenAI Equity:** President Trump has confirmed talks about taking a government stake in OpenAI, arguing the American people should benefit from AI's success ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/06/the-trump-administration-might-take-an-equity-stake-in-openai/), [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2188942/the-trump-administration-is-reportedly-in-talks-about-taking-a-stake-in-openai/)).
- **China's AGI Talent Grab:** Tencent hires former OpenAI researcher Yao Shunyu as Chief AI Scientist, bringing OpenAI's playbook to China's AGI push ([Tekedia](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxQcmUtU1VtLTRaOWhobmd3amF0QjNyWDR4OWl4WWFmc2tGM2FHNV96bk9MOVYwLVdNQmhKaTlhZ3pJc2dDT2M2YUtQeHJPVUpsR01oZkhwU2R5Q2gyV1pRWjNQQ0lVTE9sYnFFZU12Mm1iVzgzMHZEbnFhV2FHOEhRRXdzNGc0M2VqNHF1akowY213MXFJYnZrYkdQQWZaT1dYOFJ5ellabw), [Crypto Briefing](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE9kVDJRNnl5RG9IT1pWLW9rQm9zSkp5SWVXMkcwbk8xOHFlV29fNjBkcFJQMGk5UzlKRmJ5QTdIUmNNdkJDenZndlhZMVFDX0s4SnhwSVMyUW52bDRGSGdzTERPa3FndGlk)).
- **Meta's AI Clickbait Factory:** The company's standalone AI app now features a 'For You' section filled with fully AI-generated clickbait stories, raising questions about content quality and authenticity ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/944235/meta-app-ai-clickbait-articles)).
- **Gaming's Biggest Week:** Summer Game Fest is underway with PlayStation's single-player focus (God of War Laufey), the Wholesome Direct showcasing over 50 games, and Fellow Traveller's Story-Rich showcase highlighting narrative-driven titles ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/games/939206/summer-game-fest-playstation-xbox-gaming-events-2026), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/games/944406/fellow-traveller-story-rich-showcase-2026-announcements-trailers), [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/entertainment/943977/wholesome-direct-2026-cute-games-trailers)).
- **Military Autonomous Truck:** Harbinger partners with American Rheinmetall to develop an uncrewed military ground vehicle using a hybrid/electric chassis ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/06/harbinger-gears-up-for-war-with-autonomous-military-truck-program/)).
- **EV Charging Access Crisis:** Many 'public' chargers are actually behind dealer gates, with limited hours and Wild West pricing, frustrating first-time EV drivers ([Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/06/when-public-charging-stations-arent-so-public-and-why-it-matters/)).
- **Community Spotlight:** Hacker News discusses Valve's P2P networking being broken for over two months, a 100,000-watt FM signal being severed, and the open-source NTSC-rs emulator of analog TV artifacts ([GitHub](https://github.com/ValveSoftware/GameNetworkingSockets/issues/398), [Radio World](https://www.radioworld.com/news-and-business/headlines/an-ohio-valley-100000-watt-fm-signal-is-severed-in-broad-daylight), [ntsc.rs](https://ntsc.rs/)).

**Watch next:** As the Trump administration's AI equity stake talks develop, the outcome could reshape public investment in frontier technology. The Computex 2026 discussion on 'Agentic PC' promises to define the next hardware cycle, while Summer Game Fest continues to roll out major reveals. The EV charging access debate is likely to intensify as more drivers encounter dealer-restricted stations.

sports.zh: 今日体育板块迎来世界杯热身赛密集期与NBA季后赛惨案之夜的双重冲击。足球方面，英格兰、苏格兰分别以1-0和4-0击败新西兰、玻利维亚，为下周世界杯做最后演练；威尔士则2-1负于罗马尼亚，主帅贝拉米公开表示“必须更好”。羽毛球赛场，国羽女单喜忧参半——[王祉怡稳胜宫崎友花](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE93ekwyZlNRMnhfbk9MUEp1Sjd4dkFFWmNnZ3p0eU9JTHg5b21RQVMxYWFqRU9JcjNzWHdWV25tem56WGtBTHczd0ZFcG5mNmFKejJFajVUb00tTTNRNVQ3Yi1zRTl5enU3ZGJjUWJ4Y1V4RDFYREE)，而[陈雨菲止步印尼赛半决赛](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5VakR5Y3FpeUhVSHowMGN6SEFkTVRBRTIyR0JIbHl0eER1aXEyVHlNZE5FUnhYWThZbzJ5ZmMybF9mWDlSTkNqdmxRMk9NdDZXbXB0TmV2TzZoTEtfWE9pV0JHTQ)。篮球方面，NBA官方确认[亚历山大拿下雷霆生涯第27场季后赛30+](https://news.google.)，而联盟今日9场比赛中有5场分差在30分以上，被虎扑网友称为“惨案之夜”。CBA方面，上海男篮因观众多次喊“黑哨”被核减经费2万并扣3.75分。后续观察：世界杯热身赛结果将直接影响各队赛前信心，英格兰图赫尔需解决进攻效率问题；NBA季后赛分差悬殊可能引发联盟对比赛强度的重新审视；羽毛球亚锦赛裁判争议也需关注后续官方回应。
sports.en:
The last 24 hours in sports were dominated by World Cup warm-up matches, as England, Scotland, and Wales played their final friendlies. Scotland thrashed Bolivia 4-0, England edged New Zealand 1-0, but Wales fell 2-1 to Romania. In badminton, the BWF confirmed a new president, and Chinese stars Wang Zhiyi and Chen Yufei made headlines at the German Open and Indonesian Masters. The NBA playoffs saw a historic scoring night, while CBA off-season moves and a fan misconduct penalty stirred debate. Fan communities on Hupu reacted strongly to a night of blowout NBA games and the collapse of Italian clubs in European competitions.

- **England scrape past New Zealand** in a tepid warm-up: [This was a training game – Tuchel now needs to get serious](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/c3ryd490rz7o)
- **Scotland demolish Bolivia 4-0** with a first-half blitz, signaling readiness for the World Cup: [Patient, precise, clinical – are Scotland ready to make World Cup mark?](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/clyrw74l269o)
- **Wales struggle in 2-1 loss to Romania**, with coach Bellamy demanding improvement: [Wales must be better after Romania woe – Bellamy](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cy736ndkknno)
- **BWF confirms Khunying Patama Leeswadtrakul as President** for 2025-2029, signaling administrative continuity: [Khunying Patama Leeswadtrakul Confirmed BWF President](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihwFBVV95cUxNNUNRcTN6ZFhHSG13M1hDSVJBX0VWdDhTZ0U0ZmhIWXQ1VjBlQWN0bVhhdU9VTWM0UEViMERaeE82WXFVWTRCVzYtY2tYTGxVVi1xVFVVVWlnSDNVS1hNMHBnT2l3X1Vja0J1M1VqOGtzUlpUMXpiR3ZZNlJHNUlRYXk1R3BHbnc)
- **Wang Zhiyi dominates at German Open** while Chen Yufei exits Indonesia semi-finals: [Wang Zhiyi vs Tomoka Miyazaki highlights](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE93ekwyZlNRMnhfbk9MUEp1Sjd4dkFFWmNnZ3p0eU9JTHg5b21RQVMxYWFqRU9JcjNzWHdWV25tem56WGtBTHczd0ZFcG5mNmFKejJFajVUb00tTTNRNVQ3Yi1zRTl5enU3ZGJjUWJ4Y1V4RDFYREE)

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐板块呈现跨国界、跨媒介的多元动态。韩娱方面，奥运花样滑冰选手车俊焕跨界演艺引发期待；欧美乐坛爆出重磅合作——Olivia Rodrigo与The Cure主唱Robert Smith将在新专辑中合唱；中国演艺圈突传噩耗，33岁男星金泽离世令业内震惊；微博社区则因某知名男星口碑翻车、TF家族成员舞台出圈等话题持续沸腾。以下为各区域详细报道。

- [Olympic Figure Skater Cha Jun Hwan In Talks To Star In New Drama](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845920wpp/olympic-figure-skater-cha-jun-hwan-in-talks-to-star-in-new-drama) — 韩国花滑明星车俊焕被曝有望出演tvN情景喜剧《Palace Land》，其经纪公司Fantagio已确认正在洽谈。
- [Olivia Rodrigo Reveals New Album Has Duet With the Cure’s Robert Smith](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/olivia-rodrigo-robert-smith-duet-whats-wrong-with-me-cure-1236768701/) — Olivia Rodrigo在巴塞罗那Primavera Sound音乐节上惊喜请出Robert Smith，首次公开两人合作曲目《What's Wrong With Me》，新专辑将于一周内发行。
- [33岁金泽惊爆家中猝逝 李凯馨悼甜宠剧对手：我会想念你](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE9fU09wYWtRd1FYWVp2aUlpUFJuQUhSM19qelVMWG40bmpPWWFYY3N2SmR6MnBVdzFuTHh3eE0zdmZVTzR6c1NrZDN5ZnZaRG83VnlRVl96ZTVSNDNlUi1WaUcxbmcxRTdmQ09mUWZR) — 中国男星金泽于家中猝逝，年仅33岁，其主演甜宠剧《我才不要和你做朋友呢》搭档李凯馨发文悼念，死因尚未公布。
- [Marlon Wayans Reveals Melissa Joan Hart Was Supposed To Play Anna Faris’ Role In ‘Scary Movie’](https://deadline.com/2026/06/melissa-joan-hart-scary-movie-anna-faris-wayans-brothers-1236942910/) — 《惊声尖笑》系列编剧兼主演Marlon Wayans透露，Anna Faris标志性的Cindy角色最初属意Melissa Joan Hart，但因档期等原因未能成行。
- [Netflix Film Chief Dan Lin Says Streamer Has “Accepted” It Won’t Work With Directors Who Want Theatrical Releases](https://deadline.com/2026/06/netflix-films-theatrical-release-dan-lin-1236942864/) — Netflix电影部门主席Dan Lin公开表态，流媒体已接受无法与坚持院线上映的导演合作，引发业内对影院与流媒体裂痕的讨论。
- [Seo In Young Announces Plans To Remarry](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845917wpp/seo-in-young-announces-plans-to-remarry) — 韩国歌手徐仁英宣布与内容公司NP的CEO崔志勋（年长6岁）订婚，计划今年再婚。
- [Scott Pelley Shows Appreciation for Supporters Following ’60 Minutes’ Firing](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/scott-pelley-60-minutes-firing-thanks-supporters-1236615488/) — CBS《60分钟》资深记者Scott Pelley因与新高管矛盾被解雇，随后在社交平台感谢支持者，事件折射传统新闻编辑部的权力更迭。
- [最新 | 热搜第一！知名男星，口碑翻车？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidEFVX3lxTE1JUVAwRDF5bkdmVTFFS3VwcUhBMjVLWmNrQ3hzbFVTLVVWVElZOEVtRVdsTTcwbGJTSjRwbHR4VXE4RFVJNVJCME5kanE2Z0FGbTE0Wm1KUEdLcHplcHJKZzRwSTVDZGpiWTFaTkh4UHY1VFN6) — 微博热搜第一出现某知名男星口碑翻车事件，具体内容尚未明朗，但已引发大规模讨论。

**后续观察**：金泽的突然离世让中国年轻演员健康问题再次成为焦点，警方调查与官方声明预计将主导后续舆论。Olivia Rodrigo与Robert Smith的合作或将打破流行与另类摇滚的次元壁，新专辑销量值得追踪。Netflix对院线导演的强硬立场可能加速好莱坞制作格局重组。微博社区中“口碑翻车”事件若涉及具体艺人，可能引发粉丝群体新一轮舆论战。
entertainment.en:
The past 24 hours in entertainment have been marked by a mix of personal milestones, industry upheaval, and viral moments. In Korea, an Olympic figure skater pivots to acting and a veteran singer announces remarriage, while K-pop groups continue their promotional runs. Hollywood is reeling from the fallout of the Paramount-WBD merger opposition and the firing of a '60 Minutes' veteran, but also celebrating creative collaborations like Olivia Rodrigo's duet with Robert Smith. In China, the sudden death of 33-year-old actor Jin Ze has shocked fans and the industry. Social media platforms are abuzz with fan-captured moments and trending controversies.

- **Olympic skater Cha Jun Hwan** is in talks to star in tvN sitcom 'Palace Land,' marking a rare crossover from sports to K-drama ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845920wpp/olympic-figure-skater-cha-jun-hwan-in-talks-to-star-in-new-drama)).
- **Seo In Young** announces plans to remarry CEO Choi Ji Hoon, adding a personal chapter to her career ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845917wpp/seo-in-young-announces-plans-to-remarry)).
- **ILLIT** scores their first music show win for 'It's Me' on 'Music Core,' signaling strong rookie momentum ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1845908wpp/watch-illit-takes-1st-win-for-its-me-on-music-core-performances-by-aespa-treasure-and-more)).
- **Olivia Rodrigo** surprises Primavera Sound with a duet with The Cure's Robert Smith, revealed as a track on her upcoming album ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/music/news/olivia-rodrigo-robert-smith-duet-whats-wrong-with-me-cure-1236768701/)).
- **Scott Pelley** expresses gratitude after being fired from '60 Minutes' by new EP Nick Bilton, a move that has sparked industry debate over editorial direction ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/scott-pelley-60-minutes-firing-grateful-1236942839/)).
- **Charlie Puth** cancels Orlando show due to illness, disappointing fans on his 'Whatever's Clever!' tour ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/charlie-puth-cancels-florida-concert-show-tour-illness-1236942873/)).
- **Chinese actor Jin Ze** dies suddenly at 33, just after wrapping a drama; the news has gone viral and raised questions about health and overwork in the industry ([联合早报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMibkFVX3lxTE9fU09wYWtRd1FYWVp2aUlpUFJuQUhSM19qelVMWG40bmpPWWFYY3N2SmR6MnBVdzFuTHh3eE0zdmZVTzR6c1NrZDN5ZnZaRG83VnlRVl96ZTVSNDNlUi1WaUcxbmcxRTdmQ09mUWZR)).
- **TF家族 Zhang Hanrui's moon dance** captivates nearly 20 million viewers on Weibo, highlighting the power of fan-driven virality ([新浪网](https://news.google.)).

**Watch next:** Keep an eye on the premiere of Olivia Rodrigo's new album (expected within a week) for further chart impact, and on the ongoing developments in the Paramount-WBD merger saga as industry workers mobilize. In Korea, the drama 'Reborn Rookie' and 'My Royal Nemesis' are generating buzz with each new episode, while the Chinese entertainment community mourns Jin Ze, potentially prompting discussions on mental health and working conditions.

美股.zh:
美股经历“过山车”一周：前半周标普500刷新历史新高，周五却遭抛售潮，单日跌幅为近三个月最大。半导体股票的‘崩溃式反转’是主要推手，VIX恐慌指数终于追上其他波动指标，显示市场已从贪婪切换至恐惧。不过，长线资金并未离场——伯克希尔新CEO Greg Abel完成首笔重大交易，斥资数十亿美元投资AI，巴菲特在CNBC采访中明确表示此笔交易由Abel主导，标志后巴菲特时代投资风格的独立转向。同时，比特币跌至2024年以来最低，但华尔街又掀起一股新的加密货币热潮：基于Hyperliquid平台的HYPE ETF受到追捧，投机资金在寻找新的出口。展望下周，美联储主席Warsh就任后的首次公开讲话将成市场风向标。

- [Here are 3 forces that drove a whirlwind week for the stock market](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/06/here-are-3-forces-that-drove-a-whirlwind-week-for-the-stock-market.html)
- [Abel goes his own way with new Berkshire investments, including billions for AI](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/06/abel-goes-his-own-way-with-new-berkshire-investments-including-billions-for-ai.html)
- [Bitcoin is cratering, but a new Wall Street crypto hype is on the rise](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/06/bitcoin-price-crash-crypto-hype-hyperliquid-etfs.html)
- [Wall Street's 'fear gauge' punches back as the 'crash up' in chip stocks finally reverses](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/06/wall-streets-fear-gauge-punches-back-as-the-crash-up-in-chip-stocks-finally-reverses.html)

美股短期面临获利回吐压力，但AI主题的资本开支信号（伯克希尔、台积电等）并未中断，调整后或为长线买入点。
美股.en:
US equities experienced a dramatic reversal on Friday, with the S&P 500 sliding from earlier record highs as an 'avalanche of selling' hit tech and semiconductor stocks. The VIX volatility index finally surged, ending a period where it lagged other fear gauges. Meanwhile, Berkshire's new CEO Greg Abel made waves with an AI-focused investment, and a new crypto product (HYPE ETFs) gained traction as bitcoin fell to 2024 lows.

- **Three forces drove the week**: the whirlwind of selling on Friday crushed stocks, reversing midweek gains. The 'crash up' in chip stocks reversed, with the VIX finally catching up. See CNBC’s recap [here](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/06/here-are-3-forces-that-drove-a-whirlwind-week-for-the-stock-market.html) and the semiconductor reversal [here](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/06/wall-streets-fear-gauge-punches-back-as-the-crash-up-in-chip-stocks-finally-reverses.html).
- **Berkshire's new era**: Greg Abel has 'launched' with his first major deal, investing billions in AI, signaling a shift in the conglomerate's strategy under new leadership [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/06/abel-goes-his-own-way-with-new-berkshire-investments-including-billions-for-ai.html).
- **Crypto bifurcation**: Bitcoin crashed to its lowest since 2024, but investor enthusiasm shifted to HYPE ETFs – a new Wall Street product tied to hyperliquid platforms [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/06/bitcoin-price-crash-crypto-hype-hyperliquid-etfs.html).
- **Fed actions**: Kevin Warsh was sworn in as Fed chair and the FOMC unanimously selected him [Fed release](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/other20260522a.htm); the Board also issued enforcement actions against former bank employees and removed additional references to 'reputation risk' [Fed](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/enforcement20260528a.htm) and [Fed](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260602a.htm).

**Signal**: The rapid rotation out of chips and into defensives suggests a risk-off mood heading into the next week; watch for follow-through selling as the market digests the implications of a hawkish Fed and rising bond yields.

欧洲经济.zh:
欧洲央行（ECB）成为本周G7中最鹰派的央行。面对通胀再次逼近3%（远超2%目标）而经济增长疲软的‘滞胀’困境，市场预期ECB将在6月和7月连续加息。行长拉加德近期讲话强调了女性领导力与货币政策独立性，但实际利率路径的争议正在扩大。西班牙旅游市场创下新纪录，显示出南欧服务业的韧性，但另一方面，欧洲超市食品价格依然居高不下，消费者购买力持续承压。此外，美国国防部长Hegseth在诺曼底登陆纪念活动上称欧洲面临‘危险意识形态入侵’，尽管是政治言论，但可能影响跨大西洋贸易与投资情绪。

- [ECB’s Stagflation Dilemma: Inflation Credibility vs Weak Eurozone Growth](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirAFBVV95cUxNTUk4RE9XdU1aYjRmcWwyT2poWk1xNVRwS3VmVFpBTloyTVBqNFh6aHNOM0M2Vk5TeU1KQ21QcXVub0djUXNmNEQ3U3ROZmVqVUtnSXpYTDl4R3lNSXJ2Rm9GMEZONWFpREN4SEpfUFVPQl9VVDc1c1RsSkpmQjd5eFJGNmRidnJYcldUbnBYQ0tsSmJycG9QYnRxM29FbmcwOGZUbG9OUWdTWjJi)
- [ECB Steps Up as G7’s Lead Hawk With Interest-Rate Hike Primed](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQOHQ2cTBlTHBFMnNTVGtKYnJzN01LTDRXSzlOd2NVWVNRd1ZHQnlEcllwMGNZbXNDNVl5ZGk3c0hfRnltbXFFRThFZjczT0NxM3Q0ZVlrVlpvZlJKR3hQN3BSR0pXbjFDV0hPNEloVmlpVzd3VnVEUkU3dXV3NmtGX2QwSHZfYzVUbVlrLS0yX2NaZTFQbkRVVHYwNmtoZThKUnk2LVhTLWgzOVk1OVlrY0pB)
- [Spain’s travel market leads Europe as tourism hits new records](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxNbzlnNFBQV2ZpLUN3MEpSRDc5RmpJSU8zbE5HRTlFd2d2Tl9kRXFiVVFHYllyNEVTaWdfMk9feTRZVFJFS1JveF9kMW1JTDhoQ0w5T3NuZS1GU2E3N0FjeTY5MEJBSlB4YjA1SWxYYzV0M1pxam83ZWRWNVktOExDTk1LaC1Qdzc1NmtNSHI4YllTSTB2OU0tZDhHWHpiWTRLeEhGTlIybTdhZ25Wc0p3)
- [Supermarkets without relief: why food in Europe is still expensive](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPcFY0Y3ZaZldIUkJ1NGpSaTVBY0dtMWQ4bWQ4WjZSb3VzQ3hwS2QyUS1oOTRhb2lIR3RodERsQmZGd21sdV9rWmVmSkNtU3p1ZUF1TTY0SUZJT3RFamNpYURwenZ6bnM3cHprMFpucXR6UkhTa3F6TjVQVkhydjhLZFpncmQyWGQ5LVlCSHpHVUQ4QUYtTlh4VGIzNGk)

欧洲央行加息箭在弦上，但市场对衰退风险的定价尚不充分，欧元区风险资产（尤其是信用债）面临重定价。
欧洲经济.en:
European markets are bracing for an ECB rate hike as inflation nears 3% and growth remains weak, creating a classic stagflation dilemma. Central bank officials have stepped up hawkish rhetoric, while food prices stay elevated despite a strong tourism season in Spain. The US job surge has added to global rate-hike bets, tightening funding windows for risk assets.

- **ECB primed for hikes**: Markets expect two rate increases as inflation climbs toward 3%, with the ECB stepping up as the G7's lead hawk [Bloomberg](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisgFBVV95cUxQOHQ2cTBlTHBFMnNTVGtKYnJzN01LTDRXSzlOd2NVWVNRd1ZHQnlEcllwMGNZbXNDNVl5ZGk3c0hfRnltbXFFRThFZjczT0NxM3Q0ZVlrVlpvZlJKR3hQN3BSR0pXbjFDV0hPNEloVmlpVzd3VnVEUkU3dXV3NmtGX2QwSHZfYzVUbVlrLS0yX2NaZTFQbkRVVHYwNmtoZThKUnk2LVhTLWgzOVk1OVlrY0pB) and Crypto Briefing [here](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTFBqZmNWWFcxWWhCNTNkSm10UWZhdE1XYTVnVmlsM3ZrNHU2QVZRT0sxNHE1U0VocUxIeU9mUHR2QkFMc3kxUnJDZUFVN1BzdDUxSGFaRi1pcTI0ZHRYUzdrYVBLUXpKZml2).
- **Food inflation persists**: Supermarkets across Europe still face high prices, with no relief in sight as supply chain costs remain elevated [logos-pres.md](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinAFBVV95cUxPcFY0Y3ZaZldIUkJ1NGpSaTVBY0dtMWQ4bWQ4WjZSb3VzQ3hwS2QyUS1oOTRhb2lIR3RodERsQmZGd21sdV9rWmVmSkNtU3p1ZUF1TTY0SUZJT3RFamNpYURwenZ6bnM3cHprMFpucXR6UkhTa3F6TjVQVkhydjhLZFpncmQyWGQ5LVlCSHpHVUQ4QUYtTlh4VGIzNGk).
- **Spain’s tourism boom**: The travel market leads Europe as tourism hits new records, providing a rare bright spot for the region's economy [Breaking Travel News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirwFBVV95cUxNbzlnNFBQV2ZpLUN3MEpSRDc5RmpJSU8zbE5HRTlFd2d2Tl9kRXFiVVFHYllyNEVTaWdfMk9feTRZVFJFS1JveF9kMW1JTDhoQ0w5T3NuZS1GU2E3N0FjeTY5MEJBSlB4YjA1SWxYYzV0M1pxam83ZWRWNVktOExDTk1LaC1Qdzc1NmtNSHI4YllTSTB2OU0tZDhHWHpiWTRLeEhGTlIybTdhZ25Wc0p3).
- **US jobs data impacts Europe**: The strong US payrolls report stirs global rate hike speculation, jolting European markets as well [MSN](https://news.google.).

**Signal**: The ECB’s hawkish pivot will likely compress European risk asset valuations further, especially for growth, while tourism-dependent economies like Spain may outperform. Expect volatile fixed-income markets as rate hike expectations solidify.

中国经济.zh:
国家外汇管理局公布5月外汇储备34422.38亿美元，环比增加316.91亿美元，延续回升态势，主要受美元走弱及估值效应支撑。但市场更关注结构性问题：港股通机制下，国际投资者无法买入内地最热门的AI上市公司股票，与此同时，内地投资者也无法参与港股AI新股认购。证监会主席吴清在周末表态将加强对程序化交易的监管，这可能影响高频量化策略的活跃度。香港方面，受益于全球财富管理中心地位超越瑞士，高端奢侈品商场录得连续数月双位数增长，JD.com也在香港开设首家线下MALL并计划三年拓至8家。此外，‘大空头’Michael Burry透露正在买入某中国股票（坊间猜测为BYD或PDD），其观点与当前中国消费复苏分歧形成对照。

- [The Stock Connect problem: why can’t investors buy the mainland’s top AI stocks?](https://news.google.)
- [中国5月外汇储备34422.38亿美元，环比增加316.91亿美元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE12WFlKRm5ucDd0U3U3cUhDUzhBbkZ0OERBb0ctY2QyS0xLT0lyc1dadGttanZzUDBDbjN0b2VSM1VPMl9Edjh3VVllRFNsMFNjSENn)
- [Hong Kong luxury malls thrive amid IPO gains, housing recovery](https://news.google.)
- [BYD, Haidilao Or PDD: ‘Big Short’ Investor Michael Burry Says He's Buying One Of These Chinese Stocks As Earnings Loom](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxNUlJpRS1RX2RnemZ0T0pjSEtSVVM3SHA1UzZoWWJPdXlqWDU3UklUV04tS0ZVdXd4NWdWNGNzb3ltVTZkMWNRQ0xXdWxfVHVfWHFLbkZQY2tqX0hMclRocTB1THpUQzZqbEx6Y3JaaVB6MXhFbmswYldUcEdDUkNRZ1ZEWWdiN1hfVWsyT1lhaXFxNDRYQ1JnSUFqaHZpV0R5WmRBUzZGalVFYzR3NE5XVEIxUmxHNWFyeHc)

中国股市正面临“核心资产易主”的阵痛：AI公司上市路径与外资准入不匹配。短期内，互联互通机制的修补预期可能催化港股科技股行情。
中国经济.en:
China's markets are navigating a mix of positive data (rising forex reserves, Hong Kong luxury boom) and structural frustrations (Stock Connect blocking AI stocks, SpaceX IPO ban). Regulators are tightening programme trading rules, while individual stock stories like BYD and tin miners draw investor attention. The divergent fortunes of luxury malls and mainland students' reconsideration of Hong Kong highlight economic bifurcation.

- **Stock Connect AI bottleneck**: International and Hong Kong investors cannot buy mainland's hottest AI stocks, which have surged in recent IPOs. The scheme's limitations frustrate cross-border traders, and mainland investors are also locked out of AI IPOs listed elsewhere. This is a major market access issue [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3356193/why-cant-investors-buy-mainlands-hottest-ai-stocks-stock-connect).
- **Hong Kong luxury mall boom**: Driven by wealth hub status, IPO gains, and housing recovery, high-end malls see improved revenues. Hard luxury and jewellery have grown for consecutive months [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3355967/its-wealth-effect-hong-kong-luxury-malls-thrive-amid-ipo-gains-housing-recovery).
- **CSRC to regulate programme trading**: The chairman announced enhanced oversight of algorithmic trading to clamp down on misconduct, a move that could impact hedge funds and institutional investors [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3356217/china-will-enhance-regulation-programme-trading-csrc-chairman).
- **Michael Burry eyes a Chinese stock**: The 'Big Short' investor is reportedly buying one of BYD, Haidilao, or PDD ahead of earnings, signaling value opportunities in Chinese equities [Stocktwits](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiugFBVV95cUxNUlJpRS1RX2RnemZ0T0pjSEtSVVM3SHA1UzZoWWJPdXlqWDU3UklUV04tS0ZVdXd4NWdWNGNzb3ltVTZkMWNRQ0xXdWxfVHVfWHFLbkZQY2tqX0hMclRocTB1THpUQzZqbEx6Y3JaaVB6MXhFbmswYldUcEdDUkNRZ1ZEWWdiN1hfVWsyT1lhaXFxNDRYQ1JnSUFqaHZpV0R5WmRBUzZGalVFYzR3NE5XVEIxUmxHNWFyeHc).
- **Forex reserves rise**: May reserves reached $3,442.24 billion, an increase of $31.69 billion from April, providing a cushion against capital outflows [第一财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiU0FVX3lxTE12WFlKRm5ucDd0U3U3cUhDUzhBbkZ0OERBb0ctY2QyS0xLT0lyc1dadGttanZzUDBDbjN0b2VSM1VPMl9Edjh3VVllRFNsMFNjSENn).

**Signal**: The disconnect between China's macro stability (reserves, luxury consumption) and market access frustrations (AI stocks, SpaceX ban) suggests a bifurcated market where selective stock picking (like Burry's play) and regulatory changes will drive near-term moves.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
同花顺社区周末热度集中在三方面：新股、商品涨价与个股异动。欧尚元冲刺创业板，但其2025年毛利率骤降7个百分点、核心产品分离纯化装备毛利率跌近10个百分点，反映出IPO审核趋严下企业财务质量受质疑。锡价半年飙涨40%，锡业股份斥资1.77亿元押注‘北方锡都’，散户围绕该资源的‘暗战’逻辑展开热议。另一焦点是某深圳公司股价暴跌后报警，市场猜测涉及内幕交易或财务问题，社区讨论风险偏好明显下降。此外，**崔东树数据**显示5月新能源车平均促销力度降至9.8%的中高位，乘用车降价车型仅20款，暗示车企价格战可能暂告段落，对板块情绪构成短期利好。

- [欧尚元冲刺创业板上市：2025年毛利率同比降7个百分点](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE04MmdCdW93TGtWQVhSdnlHU0xqUWRpV0xuZ2xSamVjZWpEd0NRSXo4NTdIYl9JVDR0V0FMY3Rjb0gwNzh0ZnVhWWlrQWdjdnIzYVZEc2xPRUtXUW9FWXc)
- [锡价半年飙涨40％下的资源暗战，锡业股份1.77亿元押注“北方锡都”胜算几何？](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5ZeXFBb082X0xzTGM5SW92V2lQY1RPZVFBQzdGSnZIb2JWaklZNlZPdUNiWHc1Q0lOTHNaY2N5QWh5STdmWUxVU2FGX2lfSUhwR1VkV0lLRklLTmpQRUE)
- [股价暴跌！深圳一公司：已第一时间报警](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE03MkduM3hSa3ZtMTFzVUt6TlBacE9UN1ZFVlVyQkRDMWNXbzJ0ZDJDNVJLV2dUZmJnZnExZjZrWlhRS01HeE9ldExBY1RBdzh2U0RJQVlJZnJUY294Mnc)
- [崔东树：5月乘用车降价20款 新能源车促销降至9.8%中高位](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE42YWZlNjgtbUJ1ZXVMUGRSdlM5NlZVdk1icm4zSU03WWFWd1EwckRmbXk1Y1NJbVJnWW9SMWlPRDFLVy1xbVFWSV9XVlR5MGZZd0otaDk1SWVvYU8zX3c)

社区情绪呈现‘避险+挖掘结构性机会’特征，投资者对高毛利率下滑的新股保持警惕，但对资源涨价和新能源降价放缓的边际变化较为敏感。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Retail investor chatter in China focused on IPO listings (Oushangyuan with falling margins, a high-lottery-rate new stock), commodity price movements (tin surging 40% in six months, LNG price crossover), and individual stock stories (a Shenzhen company's stock collapse, a stock cooperating with Nvidia hitting record highs). The community also noted auto price cuts and a securities firm achieving carbon neutrality.

- **IPO watch**: Oushangyuan is rushing to list on ChiNext despite a 7 percentage point gross margin decline in 2025, with its core separation equipment margin falling nearly 10 points [同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE04MmdCdW93TGtWQVhSdnlHU0xqUWRpV0xuZ2xSamVjZWpEd0NRSXo4NTdIYl9JVDR0V0FMY3Rjb0gwNzh0ZnVhWWlrQWdjdnIzYVZEc2xPRUtXUW9FWXc). A high-lottery-rate IPO is expected, drawing retail interest [同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFAzN0g0NWdVaDdBTU5YREJUbW9UVXBfOUQwZ3lCWFR2SjhpRmhCWTBRejVPTVg1MzVWamcyQTJyUm96QXp3Q05SYTB1UHp1cEs1UVFnUE4zeHFrcTJwNXc).
- **Commodity plays**: Tin prices have surged 40% in half a year, with Yunnan Tin betting 177 million yuan on the 'Northern Tin Capital' – a potential resource war [同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5ZeXFBb082X0xzTGM5SW92V2lQY1RPZVFBQzdGSnZIb2JWaklZNlZPdUNiWHc1Q0lOTHNaY2N5QWh5STdmWUxVU2FGX2lfSUhwR1VkV0lLRklLTmpQRUE). LNG prices also saw a technical crossover, indicating near-term momentum [同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE13eWlhYWNsekNTdklVQkM4UHdTTkpteG9uMllSdUthNHBhemI5WVRCdVhIMDZwTnNhQlYxLWxjUHZ5cTAwQnVmYm1aTFBoWHlWbkZQb0l6SWlScjc1MHNaemJ1UQ).
- **Auto sector pressure**: 5月 saw 20 models with price cuts; new energy vehicle promotions fell to a medium-high level of 9.8%, indicating competitive intensity [同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE42YWZlNjgtbUJ1ZXVMUGRSdlM5NlZVdk1icm4zSU03WWFWd1EwckRmbXk1Y1NJbVJnWW9SMWlPRDFLVy1xbVFWSV9XVlR5MGZZd0otaDk1SWVvYU8zX3c).
- **Stock specific**: Stock code 300319 (cooperating directly with Nvidia) hit a record high [同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBDbHcwMEMxcHJKcDlSLU9ZbTdIU3NxNV9tcTF2UlRTUU5nQUxLZ3U5YTl1ODNEVW5KY0oyRk9WTW5LNDRhSHlZR3BUUDJqSVlGRmRvYmpmQnN1NzJYTWc). Meanwhile, a Shenzhen company saw a sharp stock crash and reportedly called the police [同花顺财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE03MkduM3hSa3ZtMTFzVUt6TlBacE9UN1ZFVlVyQkRDMWNXbzJ0ZDJDNVJLV2dUZmJnZnExZjZrWlhRS01HeE9ldExBY1RBdzh2U0RJQVlJZnJUY294Mnc).

**Signal**: Retail sentiment remains speculative, with a focus on IPO arbitrage, commodity cycles, and AI-linked stocks, but margin compression in manufacturing and sudden crashes indicate underlying fragility. Investors should watch for regulatory moves on algorithmic trading and further metal price volatility.

欧美.zh: 中东战火与美国外交摩擦交织：以色列在黎巴嫩南部击杀三名高级军官（包括一名将军），黎巴嫩军方称其为“侵略”，以军正在调查（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cj0g8jymg92o)）。同日美国与伊朗在波斯湾互袭，美方打击伊朗无人机和雷达，伊朗宣称攻击了美军在科威特和巴林的基地，停火协议濒临崩溃（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvgzgyjk2weo)）。五角大楼据报将以色列间谍威胁等级上调至“临界”，显示美以互信恶化（[Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/6/pentagon-said-to-raise-threat-level-on-israel-spying-to-critical)）。此外，乌克兰无人机罕见袭击圣彼得堡，俄称“史无前例”（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cg7498kz808o)）。美国防长赫格塞斯在诺曼底纪念日演讲中攻击欧洲移民政策，称其为“海滩入侵”，被批不合时宜（[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c802e7jk458o)）。当前局势：中东危局未见缓和，美欧裂痕加深，冲突外溢风险上升。
欧美.en:
The European and American desks were dominated by escalating military conflicts and diplomatic friction. The US-Iran exchange of strikes, the Israeli killing of a Lebanese general, and the Ukrainian drone attack on St. Petersburg all represent significant escalations. Meanwhile, the Pentagon's raised alert on Israeli spying and Hegseth's D-Day attack on migration underscore growing strain within the Western alliance.

- **US and Iran trade strikes in the Gulf**: The US military struck Iranian drones and radar sites, and Iran responded by targeting US bases in Kuwait and Bahrain. The ceasefire is under severe strain ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/6/pentagon-said-to-raise-threat-level-on-israel-spying-to-critical?traffic_source=rss)).
- **Israel kills Lebanese general**: Three high-ranking Lebanese soldiers were killed in an Israeli airstrike on their vehicle in south Lebanon. Hezbollah's response could open a new front ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cj0g8jymg92o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)).
- **Ukrainian drones hit St. Petersburg**: For the first time since the war began, residents of Russia's second city were told to stay indoors. The attack marks a strategic shift in Ukraine's targeting ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cg7498kz808o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)).
- **Hegseth attacks Europe on migration at D-Day speech**: The US defence secretary used the Normandy commemoration to compare migration flows to an 'invasion,' drawing sharp criticism ([BBC](https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c802e7jk458o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)).
- **Pentagon raises Israel spying threat to critical**: Internal reports cite increased espionage activity amid the US-Israel war with Iran, signaling a breakdown of trust ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/6/6/pentagon-said-to-raise-threat-level-on-israel-spying-to-critical?traffic_source=rss)).

**Closing signal:** The convergence of military escalation in the Middle East and Ukraine, combined with transatlantic rhetorical clashes, suggests a period of heightened volatility that could reshape alliance dynamics and energy markets.
